**Continuous 2.38.9**, a community-maintained fork of the Continue VS Code extension. Continuous is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or supported by Continue Dev, Inc.

It installs alongside the original extension (its ID is `b1tninja.continuous`), brings your existing `~/.continue` configuration with it, and collects no telemetry. To update from 2.38.8, 2.38.7, 2.38.6, 2.38.5, 2.38.4, 2.38.3, 2.38.2, 2.38.1, 2.38.0, 2.36.0, 2.34.0, 2.32.0, 2.30.0, 2.28.0, 2.26.0, 2.24.0, 2.22.0, 2.20.0, 2.18.0, 2.16.3, 2.16.2, 2.16.1, 2.16.0, 2.14.0, 2.12.x, 2.10.x or 2.4.x, install the new `.vsix` the same way, or let the Marketplace update it. Coming from 2.4.1 or earlier, also see [Continued is now Continuous](https://github.com/b1tninja/continuous/releases/tag/v2.4.2-vscode) in the 2.4.2 notes: the extension ID changed.

## Install

1. Download the `.vsix` for your platform below and, optionally, check it against `SHA256SUMS.txt`.
2. Run `code --install-extension continuous-<platform>-2.38.9.vsix --force`, or in VS Code use the Extensions view: `...` → **Install from VSIX…**, then reload the window.

Requires VS Code 1.105 or newer. The packages are not code-signed. Full instructions: [install guide](https://github.com/b1tninja/continuous/blob/main/docs/continuous-install.md). Continuous is also on the VS Code Marketplace as **Continuous** (`b1tninja.continuous`).

| Platform                    | File                                                                       |
| --------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Windows x64 / Arm64         | `continuous-win32-x64-2.38.9.vsix`, `continuous-win32-arm64-2.38.9.vsix`   |
| macOS Apple Silicon / Intel | `continuous-darwin-arm64-2.38.9.vsix`, `continuous-darwin-x64-2.38.9.vsix` |
| Linux x64 / Arm64           | `continuous-linux-x64-2.38.9.vsix`, `continuous-linux-arm64-2.38.9.vsix`   |

Each platform also has an **agents** build, `continuous-<platform>-2.38.9-agents.vsix`. It adds Continuous to VS Code's Agents window through APIs that are still proposed, so it works in VS Code Insiders, or in Stable started with `code --enable-proposed-api b1tninja.continuous`. Without that it works like the normal build. See [VS Code Chat and Agents](https://b1tninja.github.io/continuous/customize/vscode-chat-and-agents).

## The CLI

The terminal agent is attached as `continuous-cli-2.38.9.tgz`. Install it on Node 22 or newer:

```sh
npm i -g https://github.com/b1tninja/continuous/releases/download/v2.38.9-vscode/continuous-cli-2.38.9.tgz
```

The package is `@b1tninja/continuous-cli` and the command is `continuous` (`continuous serve` is the headless server; the notes below call it `cn serve` where the docs do). The short command `cn` also works; both run the same program. It reads the same `~/.continuous` configuration as the extension.

## What's new since 2.38.8

Your switches now decide what they say they decide. The secret-file check and the shell checks each had a path that ignored their switch, and a folder added to the workspace was not used by the edit tools.

### Behaviour changes

- **Commands and secrets covers every file path.** With "Ask before touching credentials" off, a secret-looking file such as `.env` is no longer refused when it is attached as context, read by autocomplete or next-edit suggestions, navigated to, or shown from an open tab. Autocomplete and next-edit suggestions can therefore send such a file's contents to the model. Leaving the workspace is still refused by its own check.
- **A new switch, "Check shell commands before running them".** It is in Permissions, under Protections. It covers the checks that stopped commands before they ran: bash in PowerShell (`export`, heredocs, `&&` in Windows PowerShell 5.1), PowerShell in bash, an inline script that quoting breaks, and a program that is not installed. Off, the command runs as written and the shell reports any error. It is on by default, and it is off in the IDGAF preset. A command the shell cannot parse therefore now runs under IDGAF; keep the switch on under IDGAF to refuse those commands again.
- **Edits in an added folder work.** Folders added with `additionalFolders` in `config.yaml` count as the workspace for edits as well as reads. Search-and-replace and multi-edit used to refuse a file there as "does not exist". The auto-review path reads those folders too.

### Fixes

- **Editing a file in an added folder.** See above.
- **The secret-file switch.** Context attachments, autocomplete, next edits, code navigation and open files all follow "Ask before touching credentials", not only the file tools.
- **Shell checks are switchable.** The lint and the missing-program check were controlled only by environment variables. They are now controlled by the switch above, and the environment variables still work.
